To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the improved genetic algorithm is applied to train wavelet networks and a novel dynamic modeling and dynamic calibration methods are presented based upon improved genetic algorithm and genetic wavelet neural networks.

a novel improved genetic algorithm and a kind of new dynamic model of multi-dimensional wrist force sensors are proposed, which can improve the precision of dynamic modeling and dynamic compensating of the wrist force sensors.

a kind of new dynamic compensation method for the robot wrist force sensors is presented based on improved GA and wavelet neural network (IGAWNN), and the results show that the method can improve the training speed and the precision, and the network structure and parameters of the dynamic model can be optimized by improved genetic algorithm.

the dynamic modeling and dynamic calibration of the robot wrist sensor based on IGA and WNN.
the robot wrist force sensors, and the new dynamic modeling method and dynamic compensation method are presented based on the improved genetic algorithm and the wavelet neural networks.
the dynamic characteristics of robot wrist force sensor and the dynamic modeling and dynamic calibration of the robot wrist sensor based on the improved genetic wavelet neural networks.

the improved genetic algorithm and the wavelet neural networks have been applied successfully to dynamic modeling and dynamic compensating of robot wrist force sensors.
the improved genetic algorithm and the wavelet neural networks are effective methods for the robot wrist force sensing dynamic modeling and dynamic compensations.
the proposed method is an efficient method to solve the dynamic characteristics of the multi-dimensional wrist sensor.
